Reconsider: re-add on reclaim >640 APP / >260 STX close; trim MU if closes under 165 gap, NVDA under 170; redeploy cash only on semis stabilization.

Raise cash to ~80% defensive after 5th momentum reversal. Reconsider: re-add MU only on reclaim >195 close; trim NVDA if closes under 170; redeploy cash only on semis stabilization.

Hold NVDA and cash. NVDA +2.2% to 189.11 close on 10-08 (high 189.6 low 186.54) on 130M lighter vol, tight close-near-high, no blow-off, well above 170 trim. MU reclaimed >195 to 196.54 (+5.8%) meeting prior re-add trigger, but single-day reclaim amid AMD +11.4% parabolic to 235.56 and mixed tape (APP 629.7 still <640, PLTR 183.56 <185, STX 224.35 new low, TSLA choppy) = euphoria not broad semis stabilization. Defer MU re-entry for 2nd-day confirmation to avoid whipsaw. Reconsider: add MU starter on hold >195, trim NVDA under 170, redeploy cash only on 2-day semis hold.

Hold NVDA and cash. NVDA +1.8% to 192.57 close on 10-09 (high 195.3 low 191.06) on 183M elevated vol, breakout above 189.6, only -1.4% off high, well above 170 trim. MU failed 2nd-day confirmation: -2.1% to 192.33 close (high 196.62 low 189.5) back below 195 trigger on lighter 19.7M vol, validating prior defer. Tape still mixed: APP -4.6% to 600.32 breakdown, STX -1.2% to 221.7 new low, AMD -1.1% to 232.89 off 240.1 high topping, TSLA -0.7% choppy, PLTR marginal +1% to 185.47 on wide range not clean reclaim. Reconsider: redeploy only on 2nd-day hold NVDA above 185-190 and MU above 192-195 with broad semis holding.

Hold 100% cash defensive. Hold 100% cash defensive. Hold 100% cash defensive. Hold 100% cash defensive. No NVDA reclaim: 10-20 NVDA -0.3% to 182.64, high 185.20 tapped 185-190 breakdown but closed below, fifth close below on drying 128M vs 173M - base coiling but still capped. Hold 100% cash defensive. No NVDA reclaim: 10-21 NVDA -0.8% to 181.16, open-high 182.79, low 179.80 lower low, sixth close below 185-190 breakdown on drying 124M vs 129M - downtrend persists.
